what: A three.js carousel that wraps several panels around a 180° arc (cylinder outer face) and spins endlessly — 45° field of view, camera distance tied to panel height at 1px=1 unit, panel width min(1280, width×.58) (×.8 below 1024) · gap 50 (25) · 16:9 (1:1.1 below 640), and the panel itself bends along the same cylinder. Moving the target with wheel ×.6 and drag ×1.5 (touch ×3) makes the position follow at .085 per frame, and by that speed (±70) the panels pinch at the waist from the center line (vertical 1 − |v|×.008), lean sideways, and the red and blue split by v×.0022 (±.018). The farther from the center, the smaller (down to .65x) and darker (.55 + .45×size), with outer curvature .4, fading out at the last 15% of the arc. The camera tilts ±50 with the mouse, a point of light in front of the panel (panel width×.585, radius panel width×.862, strength .75) follows in reverse, and the hovered panel swells 25 forward at the cursor spot (following at .17). On entry, the arc unfolds from a .75x flat row over 1.75s expo.out.

options.lerp: Rate (per frame) at which position follows the target, default .085
options.wheel: Movement per 1px of wheel (0 ignores the wheel), default .6
options.wheel-axis: both (vertical wheel also turns it sideways — full-screen panel) · x (horizontal wheel only — when embedded in a page), default both
options.width: Panel width ratio (1024 and up), default .58
options.gap: Gap between panels (1024 and up), default 50
options.tilt: Amount the camera shifts away with the mouse (px), default 50
options.light: Light intensity (0 turns it off), default .75
options.pull: Amount (px) the hand-raised panel swells, default 25
options.intro: Seconds for the arc to unfold, default 1.75
options.delay: Wait before the arc unfolds (sec), default 0
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: One per panel — if an img, video or canvas is inside, it draws that, otherwise it draws a data-label placeholder
options.fx:pick: Click a panel and it moves to the center, and { index, uv } Fires it — opening the case is left to the consumer
options.--fx-index: Current center panel number (decimal) — used for outside indicators like a title roll

use: …
note: The original is a WebGPU (three r185 TSL) node material — the same formula was rewritten in GLSL. Arc radius chosen so neighboring panels sit 30° apart when there are six panels = Panel count × spacing / arc angle. The original’s panel press → panel covers the screen and brightens to open the case (0.75s expo, cover 1.05x) is a site device, so it was left out of the part — it lives in library/liquid-arc-video-portfolio/stage.js. Vertical finger swipe is handed over to page scroll. The shader is precompiled at setup
